function sql(value) {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || String(value).trim() === '') return 'NULL';
  return "'" + String(value).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
}
const body = $json.body || $json;
const publicationJobId = String(body.publicationJobId || body.publication_job_id || '').trim();
const requestedStep = String(body.retryStep || body.retry_step || '').trim();
const uuidRegex = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
const retryableSteps = new Set(['generate-brief', 'generate-prompt-pack', 'generate-images', 'generate-copy-pack']);
if (!uuidRegex.test(publicationJobId)) {
  return [{ json: { query: "SELECT false AS ok, 'publicationJobId is required' AS error;" } }];
}
const query = `
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS publication_job_events (
  event_id text PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text),
  publication_job_id uuid NOT NULL,
  event_type text NOT NULL,
  event_label text NOT NULL,
  event_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed',
  event_payload jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  error_message text,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_publication_job_events_job_created
  ON publication_job_events (publication_job_id, created_at);
WITH job AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM publication_jobs
  WHERE publication_job_id = ${sql(publicationJobId)}::uuid
  LIMIT 1
), retry_context AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(NULLIF(${sql(requestedStep)}, ''), metadata->'lastError'->>'failedStep') AS retry_step,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata->'lastError'->>'previousStatus', ''), status) AS previous_status,
    COALESCE((metadata->'lastError'->>'retryable')::boolean, false) AS retryable
  FROM job
), validation AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM job) THEN 'Publication job not found'
    WHEN (SELECT status FROM job) <> 'failed' THEN 'Only failed publication jobs can be retried'
    WHEN NOT ((SELECT retry_step FROM retry_context) IN ('generate-brief', 'generate-prompt-pack', 'generate-images', 'generate-copy-pack')) THEN 'This failed step is not retryable from the console yet'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS error
), updated AS (
  UPDATE publication_jobs pj
  SET
    status = (SELECT previous_status FROM retry_context),
    error_message = NULL,
    updated_at = now(),
    metadata = COALESCE(pj.metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
      'lastRetry', jsonb_build_object(
        'retryStep', (SELECT retry_step FROM retry_context),
        'restoredStatus', (SELECT previous_status FROM retry_context),
        'requestedAt', now()
      )
    )
  WHERE pj.publication_job_id = ${sql(publicationJobId)}::uuid
    AND (SELECT error FROM validation) IS NULL
  RETURNING pj.*
), event AS (
  INSERT INTO publication_job_events (
    publication_job_id,
    event_type,
    event_label,
    event_status,
    event_payload,
    created_at
  )
  SELECT
    publication_job_id,
    'retry-requested',
    'Retry requested from console',
    'completed',
    jsonb_build_object('retryStep', (SELECT retry_step FROM retry_context), 'restoredStatus', (SELECT previous_status FROM retry_context)),
    now()
  FROM updated
  RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN (SELECT error FROM validation) IS NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS ok,
  (SELECT error FROM validation) AS error,
  (SELECT retry_step FROM retry_context) AS "retryStep",
  (SELECT publication_job_id FROM updated) AS "publicationJobId",
  (SELECT avatar FROM updated) AS avatar,
  (SELECT scene FROM updated) AS scene,
  (SELECT format FROM updated) AS format,
  (SELECT objective FROM updated) AS objective,
  (SELECT business_profile FROM updated) AS "businessProfile",
  (SELECT asset_type FROM updated) AS "assetType",
  (SELECT status FROM updated) AS status,
  (SELECT brief FROM updated) AS brief,
  (SELECT prompt_pack FROM updated) AS "promptPack",
  (SELECT publishing_pack FROM updated) AS "publishingPack",
  (SELECT metadata->'publishingExport' FROM updated) AS "publishingExport",
  (SELECT metadata->'publishedRecord' FROM updated) AS "publishedRecord",
  (SELECT error_message FROM updated) AS "errorMessage",
  (SELECT created_at FROM updated) AS "createdAt",
  (SELECT updated_at FROM updated) AS "updatedAt";
`;
return [{ json: { query } }];
